entries.name: Reverse-current measuring relay
entries.summary: Measuring relay that operates when current flows in the opposite direction to normal, such as back-feed into a DC source.

entries.name: Percentage-biased differential current relay
entries.summary: Differential relay form whose operating threshold rises in proportion to the through current, set as a relative value.

entries.name: Neutral-current measuring relay
entries.summary: Measuring relay fed from a CT in a neutral conductor or star-point connection, responding to neutral current.

entries.name: Neutral-unbalance relay between two polyphase systems
aliases: in neutral between two multi-phase systems
entries.summary: Relay form measuring current in a link joining the star points of two polyphase systems, such as split capacitor banks.

entries.name: Earth-fault current relay
entries.summary: Measuring relay form that operates on current flowing to earth, fed from a residual connection or core-balance CT.

entries.name: Minimum-voltage measuring relay
entries.summary: Measuring relay that operates when voltage falls below a set level while some voltage is still present.

entries.name: Maximum-voltage measuring relay
entries.summary: Measuring relay that operates when the monitored voltage rises above its set level.

entries.name: Earth-fault voltage relay
entries.summary: Relay form that operates on a voltage appearing because of an earth fault, such as between a frame and earth.

entries.name: Minimum-impedance measuring relay
entries.summary: Measuring relay that compares voltage with current and operates when the apparent impedance falls below a set value.

entries.name: Insulation monitoring relay
entries.summary: Relay that continuously checks insulation resistance of an unearthed (IT) system to earth and alarms on a first fault.

entries.name: Indicating instrument general symbol
entries.summary: General circle form for any indicating instrument, with a placeholder replaced by the unit or quantity measured.

entries.name: Recording instrument general symbol
entries.summary: General square form for an instrument that keeps a time record of a quantity rather than just displaying it.

entries.name: Integrating instrument general symbol
entries.summary: General rectangle-with-band form for instruments that totalise a quantity over time, such as energy meters.

entries.name: Ohmmeter
entries.summary: Indicating instrument for electrical resistance, shown as an instrument circle marked with the ohm sign.

entries.name: Insulation resistance meter
entries.summary: Indicating instrument applying a high DC test voltage to read insulation resistance in megohms.

entries.name: Galvanometer
entries.summary: Sensitive indicating instrument used to detect very small currents or a balance point in a bridge circuit.

entries.name: Oscilloscope
entries.summary: Instrument that displays the waveform of a signal against time, drawn with a waveform inside the instrument outline.

entries.name: Recording voltmeter
entries.summary: Recording instrument that keeps a time record of voltage, drawn as a square marked V.

entries.name: Recording ammeter
entries.summary: Recording instrument that keeps a time record of current, drawn as a square marked A.

entries.name: Combined recording wattmeter and varmeter
aliases: combined active and reactive power recorder
entries.summary: Recording instrument that logs active and reactive power together from shared current and voltage inputs.

entries.name: Apparent-energy meter
entries.summary: Integrating meter that totalises apparent energy in kVAh, used where tariffs charge on kVA rather than kW.

entries.name: Bidirectional active-energy meter
entries.summary: Energy meter with separate registers for energy flowing in each direction, as used at generation and solar connection points.

entries.name: Multi-rate energy meter
entries.summary: Energy meter that switches between registers by time or tariff signal so energy is billed at different rates.

entries.name: Energy meter with maximum-demand indicator
entries.summary: Energy meter that also records the highest average power over a fixed demand interval for demand charging.

entries.name: Excess-energy meter
entries.summary: Integrating meter that counts only the energy taken while power is above a set threshold.

entries.name: Energy meter with pulse transmitter
entries.summary: Energy meter that sends a pulse output proportional to energy for remote counting, totalising or building management.

entries.name: Energy meter repeater
entries.summary: Remote register that counts pulses from a transmitting energy meter and repeats its reading at another location.

entries.name: Prepayment energy meter
entries.summary: Energy meter with credit control that disconnects supply through an integral switch when credit is used up.

entries.name: Volt-squared-hour meter
entries.summary: Integrating meter that totalises the square of voltage over time, used to assess voltage-dependent losses and stress.

entries.name: Summation energy meter
entries.summary: Integrating device that adds energy from several meters or circuits to give one total register.

entries.name: Maximum-demand indicator
entries.summary: Indicating instrument with a resettable pointer or register showing the highest averaged current or power reached.

entries.name: Phase-sequence indicator
entries.summary: Instrument that shows whether three-phase supply rotation is positive or reversed before motors are run or sources paralleled.

entries.name: Voltage presence indicating system
entries.summary: Capacitively coupled indicator on MV switchgear that shows whether each phase of a cable or busbar is energised.

entries.name: Double voltmeter
entries.summary: Instrument with two voltage movements in one case, showing running and incoming voltage side by side for synchronising.

entries.name: Double frequency meter
entries.summary: Instrument with two frequency elements showing running and incoming frequency together on a synchronising panel.

entries.name: Multifunction power meter
entries.summary: Digital panel meter that measures voltage, current, power, energy and power factor from one set of CT and VT inputs.

entries.name: Power quality analyser
entries.summary: Instrument that measures and logs harmonics, flicker, dips, swells and unbalance at a point of the network.

entries.name: Disturbance recorder
entries.summary: Recorder that captures analogue waveforms and binary signals before and after a trigger for fault analysis.

entries.name: Sequence-of-events recorder
entries.summary: Recorder that timestamps changes of state on many binary inputs so the order of operations can be reconstructed.

entries.name: Phasor measurement unit
entries.summary: Device that measures voltage and current phasors with precise time stamps so angles can be compared across a network.

entries.name: Active-power transducer
entries.summary: Measuring transducer that converts CT and VT inputs into a DC signal proportional to active power for SCADA or control.

entries.name: Voltage measuring transducer
entries.summary: Transducer that converts a VT secondary or direct voltage into an isolated analogue signal for remote measurement.

entries.name: Multi-core current transformer
entries.summary: CT with several independent magnetic cores on one primary, each with its own secondary for metering or protection.

entries.name: Summation current transformer
entries.summary: Auxiliary CT with several primary windings that adds the secondary currents of other CTs into one output.

entries.name: Interposing current transformer
entries.summary: Auxiliary CT inserted in a CT secondary circuit to correct ratio, phase shift or provide isolation for a relay.

entries.name: Rogowski coil current sensor
entries.summary: Air-cored coil around a conductor whose output voltage is proportional to the rate of change of current.

entries.name: Wound-primary current transformer
entries.summary: CT with a primary winding of several turns, used for low primary currents where a bar primary gives too little accuracy.

entries.name: Bushing current transformer
entries.summary: Toroidal CT mounted around a transformer or breaker bushing, often with a tapped multi-ratio secondary.

entries.name: Voltage transformer with two secondary windings
aliases: VT with metering and protection windings
entries.summary: VT with two separate secondary windings, typically one for metering and one for protection, each with its own fusing.

entries.name: Voltage transformer set with broken-delta residual winding
entries.summary: Three single-phase VTs whose residual windings are connected in broken delta to produce the zero-sequence voltage.

entries.name: Open-delta voltage transformer connection
entries.summary: Two phase-to-phase VTs connected in V to provide all three line voltages without a neutral reference.

entries.name: Combined instrument transformer
entries.summary: Single unit housing a current transformer and voltage transformer for each phase, typical of MV and HV metering points.

entries.name: Resistive voltage divider sensor
entries.summary: Low-power voltage sensor using a resistive divider to give a small voltage signal proportional to primary voltage.

entries.name: Low-power current transformer
entries.summary: Small iron-core CT with an integral shunt that delivers a low-level voltage signal instead of a standard secondary current.

entries.name: Optical current sensor
entries.summary: Current sensor using light in an optical fibre around the conductor, whose polarisation changes with the magnetic field.

entries.name: Numerical protection relay (IED)
entries.summary: Single relay block on an SLD that lists the protection functions it provides, with CT, VT and trip connections.

entries.name: Trip-circuit supervision relay
entries.summary: Relay that passes a small current through the trip circuit to check continuity and alarms if the circuit is broken.

entries.name: Buchholz relay
entries.summary: Gas-and-oil actuated relay in the pipe to the conservator, giving alarm on gas build-up and trip on oil surge.

entries.name: Winding temperature indicator
entries.summary: Transformer indicator that adds a CT-heated thermal image to top-oil temperature to estimate winding hot-spot temperature.

entries.name: Thermistor motor protection relay
entries.summary: Relay that monitors PTC thermistors embedded in motor windings and trips when their resistance rises at the rated temperature.

entries.name: Arc-flash point light sensor
entries.summary: Light sensor in a switchgear compartment that detects the flash of an internal arc and signals an arc-flash relay.

entries.name: Arc-flash fibre loop sensor
entries.summary: Bare optical fibre routed through switchgear that picks up arc light anywhere along its length.

entries.name: Residual current monitor
entries.summary: Device with a toroid that measures residual current and gives a warning or signal without interrupting the circuit itself.

entries.name: Definite-time delay qualifier for measuring relays
entries.summary: Qualifier added to a measuring relay symbol to show that operation follows a fixed time delay after pick-up.

entries.name: Inverse-time characteristic qualifier
entries.summary: Qualifier showing that a measuring relay's operating time falls as the measured quantity rises above its setting.

entries.name: Directional measuring element qualifier
entries.summary: Arrow qualifier on a measuring relay showing that it operates only for power or current in the marked direction.

entries.name: Relay test block
entries.summary: Multi-pole test facility between CT, VT and trip wiring and a relay, allowing safe isolation and test injection.

entries.name: Test plug
entries.summary: Plug inserted into a test block or switch to connect test equipment to the relay side while isolating the plant side.

entries.name: Current test switch with shorting contact
entries.summary: Panel test switch for CT circuits that shorts the CT side before opening the relay side, with a test jack between.

entries.name: Potential test switch
entries.summary: Panel test switch that opens a VT secondary circuit to a relay or meter so test voltages can be applied safely.

entries.name: Synchronising lamps
entries.summary: Set of lamps connected between incoming and running phases that brighten and dim with the phase difference during synchronising.

entries.name: Fault passage indicator
entries.summary: Device on an MV cable or overhead feeder that shows whether fault current has passed its location, to speed fault finding.

entries.name: Surge arrester counter
entries.summary: Counter in a surge arrester's earth lead that registers discharges and often shows leakage current.

entries.name: Vibration sensor
entries.summary: Sensor on a machine bearing that measures vibration and feeds a monitor or relay for alarm and trip.

entries.name: Partial discharge sensor
entries.summary: Sensor on switchgear, cables or transformers that picks up signals from partial discharge for insulation condition monitoring.

entries.name: Transformer gas-accumulation alarm input
aliases: substations Transformer protection and monitoring interfaces
entries.summary: Receives the defined gas-accumulation alarm from an applicable liquid-filled transformer gas relay.

entries.name: Transformer oil-surge trip interface
aliases: substations Transformer protection and monitoring interfaces
entries.summary: Transfers the applicable gas relay's oil-surge trip indication to the assigned protection logic.

entries.name: Transformer sudden-pressure trip interface
aliases: substations Transformer protection and monitoring interfaces
entries.summary: Receives the defined sudden-pressure protection contact for the assigned transformer tank.

entries.name: Transformer pressure-relief operated indication
aliases: substations Transformer protection and monitoring interfaces
entries.summary: Reports operation of the installed pressure-relief device independently of electrical fault detection.

entries.name: Transformer main-tank oil-level alarm
aliases: substations Transformer protection and monitoring interfaces
entries.summary: Reports the documented low or abnormal oil-level condition in the main tank system.

entries.name: Transformer tap-changer oil-level alarm
aliases: substations Transformer protection and monitoring interfaces
entries.summary: Separates the tap-changer oil-system level indication from the transformer main-tank indication.

entries.name: Transformer top-oil temperature alarm interface
aliases: substations Transformer protection and monitoring interfaces
entries.summary: Receives the measured top-oil temperature condition used for the defined alarm action.

entries.name: Transformer winding thermal trip interface
aliases: substations Transformer protection and monitoring interfaces
entries.summary: Carries the selected winding thermal protection result to the assigned trip logic.

entries.name: Transformer cooler common-failure alarm
aliases: substations Transformer protection and monitoring interfaces
entries.summary: Collects the assigned transformer-cooling equipment failures into a clearly named bay alarm.

entries.name: Transformer cooler supply-loss input
aliases: substations Transformer protection and monitoring interfaces
entries.summary: Reports loss of the monitored electrical supply to the transformer cooling system.

entries.name: Transformer through-fault accumulation monitor
aliases: substations Transformer protection and monitoring interfaces
entries.summary: Records the defined exposure of the transformer to external fault-current events.

entries.name: Transformer neutral-current measurement interface
aliases: substations Transformer protection and monitoring interfaces
entries.summary: Identifies the separately measured transformer neutral-current signal serving the assigned protection input.

entries.name: Transformer restricted-earth-fault zone interface
aliases: substations Transformer protection and monitoring interfaces
entries.summary: Defines the current measurement boundary used by the assigned restricted-earth-fault scheme.

entries.name: Transformer differential restraint interface
aliases: substations Transformer protection and monitoring interfaces
entries.summary: Provides the reference quantities used to restrain the selected transformer differential element.

entries.name: Transformer inrush-restraint interface
aliases: substations Transformer protection and monitoring interfaces
entries.summary: Identifies the measured or calculated inrush information used by the selected differential scheme.

entries.name: Transformer overexcitation measurement interface
aliases: substations Transformer protection and monitoring interfaces
entries.summary: Relates the transformer voltage and frequency inputs to its selected overexcitation supervision.

entries.name: Transformer bushing-monitor alarm interface
aliases: substations Transformer protection and monitoring interfaces
entries.summary: Receives the installed bushing monitor's declared condition or fault indication.

entries.name: Transformer online gas-monitor interface
aliases: substations Transformer protection and monitoring interfaces
entries.summary: Connects the selected online oil-gas monitoring system to station supervision.

entries.name: Transformer moisture-monitor interface
aliases: substations Transformer protection and monitoring interfaces
entries.summary: Identifies the measurement path from the installed oil or insulation moisture monitor.

entries.name: Transformer protection lockout distribution
aliases: substations Transformer protection and monitoring interfaces
entries.summary: Maps transformer protection initiations to the assigned lockout and breaker trip destinations.

entries.name: Tap-changer raise-command interface
aliases: substations Transformer regulation and cooling control
entries.summary: Carries a permitted request to move the tap changer in the documented voltage-raising direction.

entries.name: Tap-changer lower-command interface
aliases: substations Transformer regulation and cooling control
entries.summary: Carries a permitted request to move the tap changer in the documented voltage-lowering direction.

entries.name: Tap-changer movement-in-progress input
aliases: substations Transformer regulation and cooling control
entries.summary: Reports that the selected tap-changing mechanism is between completed operating positions.

entries.name: Tap-changer operation-complete feedback
aliases: substations Transformer regulation and cooling control
entries.summary: Confirms completion of the defined tap-changing operation at the regulator interface.

entries.name: Tap-changer upper-limit inhibit
aliases: substations Transformer regulation and cooling control
entries.summary: Blocks further movement in the assigned direction at the documented upper limit.

entries.name: Tap-changer lower-limit inhibit
aliases: substations Transformer regulation and cooling control
entries.summary: Blocks further movement in the assigned direction at the documented lower limit.

entries.name: Tap-position coded-input decoder
aliases: substations Transformer regulation and cooling control
entries.summary: Converts the installed tap-position contact code into the controller's displayed position.

entries.name: Tap-position analogue-input interface
aliases: substations Transformer regulation and cooling control
entries.summary: Identifies an analogue position signal supplied by the selected tap-position transmitter.

entries.name: Tap-change incomplete-operation alarm
aliases: substations Transformer regulation and cooling control
entries.summary: Detects failure of a requested tap movement to achieve its defined completion feedback.

entries.name: Tap-changer motor-protection interface
aliases: substations Transformer regulation and cooling control
entries.summary: Reports the assigned tap-drive motor protective-device operation.

entries.name: Automatic voltage-regulator enable
aliases: substations Transformer regulation and cooling control
entries.summary: Selects whether the defined regulator may issue automatic tap-change requests.

entries.name: Voltage-regulator deadband comparator
aliases: substations Transformer regulation and cooling control
entries.summary: Identifies the measured-voltage interval within which the regulator makes no tap-change request.

entries.name: Voltage-regulator line-drop compensation interface
aliases: substations Transformer regulation and cooling control
entries.summary: Provides the selected current and voltage quantities used by line-drop compensation.

entries.name: Parallel-transformer tap-control coordinator
aliases: substations Transformer regulation and cooling control
entries.summary: Coordinates the documented tap-control method for transformers operating on a common bus.

entries.name: Transformer circulating-reactive-current restraint
aliases: substations Transformer regulation and cooling control
entries.summary: Uses the selected reactive-current comparison to restrain unsuitable parallel regulation.

entries.name: Transformer cooling stage-one request
aliases: substations Transformer regulation and cooling control
entries.summary: Requests the first documented group of installed cooling equipment.

entries.name: Transformer cooling stage-two request
aliases: substations Transformer regulation and cooling control
entries.summary: Requests the next defined cooling group when the selected control condition is reached.

entries.name: Transformer cooler duty-standby rotation
aliases: substations Transformer regulation and cooling control
entries.summary: Assigns available cooling units according to the documented duty rotation method.

entries.name: Transformer fan run-proof supervision
aliases: substations Transformer regulation and cooling control
entries.summary: Compares the assigned cooling fan command with its operating feedback.

entries.name: Transformer oil-pump flow-proof supervision
aliases: substations Transformer regulation and cooling control
entries.summary: Uses the installed flow indication to supervise the assigned transformer oil pump.

entries.name: Protection-core CT secondary circuit
entries.summary: Identifies the CT core dedicated to the assigned protection measurement path.

entries.name: Metering-core CT secondary circuit
entries.summary: Identifies the separate CT core supplying the assigned metering circuit.

entries.name: Dedicated bus-protection CT core interface
entries.summary: Defines the CT secondary path allocated to the bus protection measurement zone.

entries.name: Dedicated transformer-protection CT core interface
entries.summary: Identifies the CT circuit assigned to a particular transformer protection winding input.

entries.name: Dedicated line-protection CT core interface
entries.summary: Identifies the assigned line-bay CT circuit serving its protective relay.

entries.name: CT secondary star-point connection
entries.summary: Shows the common connection of the assigned phase CT secondary windings.

entries.name: CT secondary single-earthing-point reference
entries.summary: Identifies the documented earthing location for the assigned interconnected secondary circuit.

entries.name: CT polarity-reference transfer
entries.summary: Carries the primary and secondary polarity relationship through the measurement drawing.

entries.name: CT secondary shorting-test boundary
entries.summary: Marks the purpose of the assigned shorting facilities at a CT test boundary.

entries.name: CT secondary protection-zone crossover
entries.summary: Identifies a current-measurement interface that affects the overlap between neighboring protection zones.

entries.name: CT multi-ratio tap selection reference
entries.summary: Identifies which documented secondary tap is used for the selected CT measurement ratio.

entries.name: CT ratio-correction calculation block
entries.summary: Converts a measured current quantity to the common basis used by the selected protection calculation.

entries.name: CT secondary burden allocation reference
entries.summary: Associates the connected measurement loads with the assigned CT secondary circuit.

entries.name: CT secondary lead-resistance allowance
entries.summary: Identifies the lead-resistance contribution considered in the assigned measurement circuit assessment.

entries.name: Summated phase-current relay input
entries.summary: Connects the assigned phase-current quantities to the selected summation measurement function.

entries.name: Neutral CT directional-reference interface
entries.summary: Provides the defined polarity and direction reference for a neutral-current protection input.

entries.name: Interposing CT ratio-matching interface
entries.summary: Shows the matching purpose of an interposing CT between assigned measurement circuits.

entries.name: CT secondary terminal identification boundary
entries.summary: Links the field CT circuit to the panel terminal and relay-channel identifiers.

entries.name: Low-power current sensor relay interface
entries.summary: Identifies the documented low-power current-sensor connection to its compatible relay input.

entries.name: Optical current measurement processing interface
entries.summary: Shows the processing boundary between an optical current sensor and its downstream measurement output.

entries.name: Protection-winding VT secondary circuit
entries.summary: Identifies the voltage-transformer winding allocated to the assigned protective relay inputs.

entries.name: Metering-winding VT secondary circuit
entries.summary: Separates the assigned metering voltage path from other voltage-transformer secondary circuits.

entries.name: Residual-voltage winding connection reference
entries.summary: Identifies the winding connection used to provide the assigned residual-voltage measurement.

entries.name: VT secondary fuse supervision interface
entries.summary: Reports the assigned voltage-circuit fuse condition to the protection or alarm system.

entries.name: VT secondary MCB auxiliary interface
entries.summary: Transfers the assigned voltage-circuit protective-device status to the relay logic.

entries.name: VT neutral-earthing connection reference
entries.summary: Identifies the documented earthing connection for the assigned voltage secondary circuit.

entries.name: Bus-voltage selection relay interface
entries.summary: Selects the voltage measurement associated with the bus supplying the protected circuit.

entries.name: Line-voltage synchronising input interface
entries.summary: Identifies the line-side voltage supplied to the assigned synchronising measurement.

entries.name: Generator-voltage synchronising input interface
entries.summary: Identifies the generator-side voltage supplied to its synchronising function.

entries.name: VT secondary test isolation boundary
entries.summary: Marks the defined separation between the station voltage source and the test measurement circuit.

entries.name: VT secondary voltage-injection boundary
entries.summary: Identifies the terminals where the assigned test voltage enters a measuring circuit.

entries.name: Broken-delta residual input interface
entries.summary: Carries the documented broken-delta winding output to the selected residual-voltage input.

entries.name: Capacitive VT carrier-coupling boundary
entries.summary: Distinguishes the voltage measuring interface from a documented carrier-coupling application.

entries.name: VT secondary phase-rotation reference
entries.summary: Preserves the identified phase sequence through the secondary voltage measurement circuit.

entries.name: VT measurement ratio scaling block
entries.summary: Scales the secondary measurement to the assigned primary-voltage basis.

entries.name: VT secondary star-point identification
entries.summary: Shows the common neutral of the documented phase-voltage secondary arrangement.

entries.name: VT duplicate-winding segregation reference
entries.summary: Keeps separately assigned voltage windings traceable through the protection and metering panel.

entries.name: VT open-circuit measurement quality flag
entries.summary: Indicates invalidity of a voltage input under its defined circuit-supervision condition.

entries.name: Voltage sensor low-energy input interface
entries.summary: Identifies the selected low-energy voltage-sensor output and its compatible relay connection.

entries.name: VT voltage-selection discrepancy alarm
entries.summary: Reports disagreement between the requested voltage reference and its selection feedback.

entries.name: Breaker-failure initiate interface

entries.name: Breaker-failure current-check gate
entries.summary: Uses the assigned current measurement to assess continued conduction after a breaker-failure initiation.

entries.name: Breaker-failure retrip output
entries.summary: Issues the documented repeat opening request before the assigned backup trip action.

entries.name: Breaker-failure upstream trip matrix
entries.summary: Maps a confirmed breaker-failure condition to the breakers required to clear the defined zone.

entries.name: Bus differential check-zone interface
entries.summary: Provides the separately defined overall check-zone condition used by a bus protection scheme.

entries.name: Bus protection isolator-replica interface
entries.summary: Relates measured disconnector positions to the current assignment used by the bus protection.

entries.name: Bus differential zone-selection block
entries.summary: Assigns the protected bay to its active bus zone using the documented scheme inputs.

entries.name: Line differential communication interface
entries.summary: Identifies the exchanged current information used by the assigned line differential scheme.

entries.name: Permissive overreach transfer-trip interface
entries.summary: Combines the defined local overreaching detection with the received permissive signal.

entries.name: Permissive underreach transfer-trip interface
entries.summary: Identifies the documented use of an underreaching local detection and remote permissive path.

entries.name: Directional-comparison blocking interface
entries.summary: Uses the assigned remote blocking information with the local directional protection decision.

entries.name: Direct transfer-trip receive interface
entries.summary: Receives the remote trip command assigned to the local breaker control scheme.

entries.name: Direct transfer-trip send interface
entries.summary: Transmits the local initiation assigned to a remote breaker opening function.

entries.name: Weak-infeed protection support interface
entries.summary: Identifies the documented support logic used where local fault contribution is limited.

entries.name: Line distance zone-selection interface
entries.summary: Associates the selected distance element with its documented reach zone and decision output.

entries.name: Auto-reclose initiation selection
entries.summary: Defines which protection operations may start the documented reclosing sequence.

entries.name: Auto-reclose lockout interface
entries.summary: Prevents further automatic closing after the defined unsuccessful-reclose condition.

entries.name: Single-pole trip selection block
entries.summary: Routes the assigned fault decision to its identified phase operating output.

entries.name: Three-pole trip conversion block
entries.summary: Converts the defined protection condition into an assigned three-pole opening request.

entries.name: Protection communication-failure fallback
entries.summary: Identifies the documented local protection behavior when its communication channel becomes unavailable.

entries.name: Current-measurement merging-unit publisher
entries.summary: Publishes the assigned sampled current quantities from the selected local measurement interface.

entries.name: Voltage-measurement merging-unit publisher
entries.summary: Publishes the assigned sampled voltage quantities from the selected measurement interface.

entries.name: Sampled-values relay subscription
entries.summary: Identifies the protection input subscription associated with a named sampled-values stream.

entries.name: Sampled-values stream quality gate
entries.summary: Uses the assigned stream-quality information before accepting the selected measurement data.

entries.name: Merging-unit analogue channel mapping
entries.summary: Maps the local sensor connections to the assigned published digital measurement channels.

entries.name: Merging-unit binary status publisher
entries.summary: Publishes the defined primary-equipment status information from the merging unit.

entries.name: GOOSE trip publisher interface
entries.summary: Identifies the event-message output carrying the assigned protection trip information.

entries.name: GOOSE trip subscriber interface
entries.summary: Maps the assigned received trip message to its defined local control output.

entries.name: GOOSE interlock publisher interface
entries.summary: Publishes the equipment states used by the assigned remote interlocking function.

entries.name: GOOSE interlock subscriber interface
entries.summary: Receives the assigned equipment-state message used by a local interlock decision.

entries.name: GOOSE supervision timeout interface
entries.summary: Reports that the expected event-message supervision interval has expired.

entries.name: Sampled-values missing-stream alarm
entries.summary: Reports loss of the assigned measurement stream at its subscriber.

entries.name: Process-bus redundant-network interface
entries.summary: Separates the two documented process-network paths serving a redundant communication arrangement.

entries.name: Station-bus supervisory interface
entries.summary: Carries the documented station-level monitoring and control data distinct from the process measurement stream.

entries.name: Process-network link-health input
entries.summary: Reports the defined physical or logical link condition on the assigned process-network connection.

entries.name: Merging-unit time-quality interface
entries.summary: Identifies the timing-quality status associated with the published measurement information.

entries.name: Digital breaker-command output boundary
entries.summary: Shows the conversion from a received digital operating request to the assigned physical breaker output.

entries.name: Digital secondary test-mode indication
entries.summary: Identifies the selected test or simulation state used by a digital-secondary application.

entries.name: Process-bus maintenance isolation boundary
entries.summary: Marks the defined separation of a selected bay's digital-secondary interfaces for maintenance planning.

entries.name: Digital-secondary channel identity cross-reference
entries.summary: Links the drawing channel names to the selected configuration and equipment documentation.

entries.name: Station GNSS time-source interface

entries.summary: Identifies the external satellite-based time reference feeding the selected station clock.

entries.name: Station clock holdover-state indication
aliases: substations Substation timing and event interfaces
entries.summary: Reports that the selected clock is operating without its normal external reference.

entries.name: PTP grandmaster timing interface
aliases: substations Substation timing and event interfaces
entries.summary: Identifies the clock distributing the selected precision-time reference to its network clients.

entries.name: PTP boundary-clock interface
aliases: substations Substation timing and event interfaces
entries.summary: Shows the timing boundary provided by a selected network clock between its upstream and downstream segments.

entries.name: PTP client synchronization status
aliases: substations Substation timing and event interfaces
entries.summary: Reports whether the assigned device accepts its required network time reference.

entries.name: IRIG-B time-distribution interface
aliases: substations Substation timing and event interfaces
entries.summary: Identifies the selected coded time connection between station clock and equipment.

entries.name: NTP station time-service interface
aliases: substations Substation timing and event interfaces
entries.summary: Shows the station network time service used by the assigned supervisory devices.

entries.name: One-pulse-per-second timing interface
aliases: substations Substation timing and event interfaces
entries.summary: Identifies the pulse timing connection associated with the selected time equipment.

entries.name: Station time-source selection block
aliases: substations Substation timing and event interfaces
entries.summary: Selects the documented time reference according to source availability and quality.

entries.name: Station clock loss-of-sync alarm
aliases: substations Substation timing and event interfaces
entries.summary: Reports loss of the station clock's accepted synchronization condition.

entries.name: Time-client quality rejection interface
aliases: substations Substation timing and event interfaces
entries.summary: Identifies the condition in which a device rejects a timing reference of unacceptable quality.

entries.name: Event recorder time-quality flag
aliases: substations Substation timing and event interfaces
entries.summary: Associates each event record with the declared quality of its timestamp reference.

entries.name: Station UTC-local display boundary
aliases: substations Substation timing and event interfaces
entries.summary: Separates the common recorded time basis from an operator's displayed local time.

entries.name: Time-distribution redundant-path interface
aliases: substations Substation timing and event interfaces
entries.summary: Identifies the independently documented timing paths serving the selected client equipment.
